claim: The initialize handshake answers protocol revision 2024-11-05.
Inbound frames are classified by presence of the id member.
A present, non-null id makes the frame a request that must be answered.
Absent or null id makes a notification, absorbed without any response.
Malformed or method-less lines answer parse error -32700 and the loop survives.
